quotes.title: HD 231701
quotes.card: HD 231701 is a yellow-white hued star in the northern constellation of Sagitta, near the southern constellation border with Aquila.
quotes.introduction: With an apparent visual magnitude of 8.97, it is too dim to be viewed with the naked eye, but can be seen with powerful binoculars or a small telescope.
